scope: Synthetic known-inertia scalar ODEs; finite-library structure and coefficient discovery. No PDE or physical-hardware claim.

comparison.sindyUses: Exactly the same acquired recordings as its active or random weak-fit arm; it does not select the commands.

grading.primary: Exact support recovery on independent held worlds; refusal counts as failure.
secondary: Postinitial held-trajectory position RMS / declared noise sigma
grading.coldLawSuccess: Exact support AND normalized coefficient error <= 0.1. Forward error is reported separately, never used to tune the fit.

qualification.development: All six worlds and both arms must finish two scored receipts with exact command/forecast binding; all weak holdout forecasts finite. SINDy refusals remain recorded. This qualifies execution, not scientific superiority.

evaluation.worldDistribution: Independent uniform family and actuator; independent uniform coefficients from the frozen generator. OOD adds the declared hidden oscillator.
evaluation.stopPolicy: Always attempt the fixed two rounds, including after an abstention; any refusal is retained and counted. Calibration refuses on any incomplete reference world.

nullgarden.pipeline: runControls, fixed top-k=2 diagonal LDA, subject/world-level within-family label permutations
nullgarden.label: 0 in-family, 1 hidden oscillator
nullgarden.independentUnit: one independently generated world; no row-wise timepoint permutation
nullgarden.missingFeaturePolicy: Refuse the complete sham, never silently remove failed worlds
nullgarden.interpretation: A separate conditional association diagnostic; neither a conformal threshold nor proof of causal identification.

generator.parameters: SHA256 domain-separated counter stream; uint32 midpoint / 2^32. Counter order is frozen in native harness.
generator.noise: Independent instrument seeded by the world seed xor 0x6a09e667; common noise across paired policies.
generator.interpretation: Deterministic pseudorandom synthetic replicates; guarantees remain conditional on the specified exchangeability model.
